blocks.text: EURIPIDES. MNESILOCHUS, Father-in-law of Euripides. AGATHON. SERVANT OF AGATHON. CHORUS attending AGATHON. HERALD. WOMEN. CLISTHENES. A PRYTANIS or Member of the Council. A SCYTHIAN or Police Officer. CHORUS OF THESMOPHORIAZUSAE—women keeping the Feast of Demeter.
SCENE: In front of Agathon's house; afterwards in the precincts of the Temple of Demeter.
